description: Coordinator-only types for ranking offers. They never leave Hivemind's own infrastructure: the internal. prefix is atproto's convention for that, and @atproto/lex keeps such lexicons out of published SDKs. Used between the coordinator, its task type modules and the matching engine.

scoringCriterion.description: One feature the ranking uses, with its weight and direction.

feature.description: Feature name defined by the task type, e.g. pickupEtaSeconds.

value.description: In the feature's own unit (seconds, meters, minor currency units).

rankCandidate.description: One accepted offer, reduced to the values the ranking needs.

score.description: Higher is better. Same scale as network.hivemind.coordinator.taskState#offerOption.score.
